title: Camera zoom — lens buttons and pinch, like WhatsApp
body: The in-app camera now zooms. Tap the lens buttons above the shutter (0.5× ultra-wide, 1×, and whatever else your iPhone has) or pinch the viewfinder to zoom smoothly — the phone switches between its physical lenses automatically, just like the built-in Camera app. The buttons match your phone's actual lenses, and the front camera is unchanged.
